reviews.title: Just what I was looking for!
reviews.text: SimplyWise is an amazing app that helps you manage your expenses in the most effortless way possible. One of the most impressive features of the app is the simplicity and speed at which receipts can be scanned and saved. The app's powerful OCR technology accurately scans receipts, making it incredibly easy to keep track of your expenses. The user experience and user interface of SimplyWise are also top-notch. The app's intuitive design and user-friendly interface make it easy to navigate and use, even for those who are not tech-savvy. The app's smooth and seamless operation makes managing expenses a breeze. Compared to other expense management apps like Zoho Expense, Expensify, and Wise, SimplyWise stands out as the winner. The app's superior features and functionalities make it the go-to choice for anyone looking for a reliable and efficient expense management app. I was so impressed with SimplyWise that I decided to upgrade to the business version, and I'm glad I did. The added features and benefits have made managing expenses for my business a lot easier and more streamlined. Overall, I highly recommend SimplyWise to anyone looking for an easy and efficient way to manage their expenses. With its outstanding features and functionalities, SimplyWise is truly a game-changer in the world of expense management.

reviews.title: Scans are not processing correctly
reviews.text: I saw this app advertised a month or two back and I was curious to try it out against Evernote or Expensify. I initially like the scan feature and it’s ability to cut and make make clean copies of the receipts or documents I was scanning. However after a few times I started to notice inconsistencies and errors. Several of my scanned documents were scanning blurry, and automatically coming up with the wrong business name, date, etc. A scan for let’s say Starbucks Coffee would display as “spectrum” with a bogus date. So I found myself having to manually adjust the error. Additionally the scans were coming out blurry for documents or not always auto cropping on large receipts. Additionally the app doesn’t appear to save this info to the cloud so I’m concerned my info won’t back up and be saved if I lose my phone. Additionally it would be nice to have a way to sun group receipts or categories based on store/practitioner/topic/etc. rather than by year. I also find that the document size for scanning is difficult to collect when trying to take photos. The emailing of receipts and not stop email confirmations and having to manually enter in the info for the receipts is also annoying. Apple app receipts were not scanning as the vendor and only appearing as apple. Super annoying. Otherwise I like the app and hope they can make some improvements to make this more function-able.

reviews.title: App is great, pricing scheme not so much
reviews.text: So far I've done the week trial and have enjoyed the app and how it mostly works. I think I've only had one receipt that didn't populate the info but I think that was because it was an old and faded one. The email function has worked decently as well, just have to remember to get the right email. The few things that I didn't like, and the reason why I'm only giving it 4 stars are: 1) the app doesn't seem to always save the settings. I think I've gone through the "set up account" thing like 4 times and it's still coming up. 2) the pricing scheme. In the app there's two choices, base and business. Simple enough, right? Well you'd think so but if you look in your subscriptions or even in the app on the app store, there's at least 8 different options, with no explanation about what they do. If they're old options, they probably shouldn't be shown let alone be able to pick them. Other than that, the app is great.

reviews.title: Where have you been all my life?
reviews.text: I’m going to sound dramatic but this is true… I’ve been looking for an app like this for SO long! I’ve tried so many other apps but they didn’t have the features I needed. I resigned myself to buying a receipt scanner, which is not cheap, and even that didn’t work as well as this little app does. I have to admit that I cringed at the yearly fee but I got to test it out for free for one week and saw how well it works. reviews.title: Great at scanning receipts, Awful at reconciling
reviews.text: It is very cool how well this app reads receipts although it doesn’t do great at handwriting so if you go to a restaurant and add a tip, you have to edit. If the app sold itself as just a depository of receipts, that would be fine. I could then go through my bank account manually and reconcile transactions however, it claims to have a reconciliation function. But it is awful. When you connect your bank account and click on a transaction, the program suggests a receipt you can either say yes or no, but you cannot search through your database to find the correct receipt, nor can you reconcile from the receipt database. And the suggestions are ridiculously wrong. Often the merchant date and amount don’t match and for some reason it gets obsessed with suggesting the same receipt for every transaction even if you’ve already reconciled that receipt to a transaction.

reviews.title: The best receipt organizer I have ever used!
reviews.text: I have tried all kinds of receipt scanners and organizers over the years, both in PC format and OSI format, to only be disappointed to the point I quit using them. Storing digital receipts is really important to me. I hate looking for paper receipts, bills, and documents that take up space and can be hard to find. When I heard about SimplyWise I was a little hopeful but very skeptical about trying it. When I read about the features, the modern layout, and the price structure, I had to try it. I am still new at using it but so far I am very pleased. It does a lot of what other apps are not able to do, at lease as easy. The one feature that I need is the ability to scan multiple page documents. I asked SimplyWise if it is possible to scan multiple pages and they respond with an answer quicker that I expected with the response that it is a feature they are currently working on. I hope it is apart of their next update, as it was indicated it will be!!! Keep it up SimplyWise! This app has the potential to be a better product than even Adobe Scan as far as simplicity of use and organization. I also appreciate the ability to store on their encrypted cloud (so all my devices has access to the same information) as well as the ease of storing on my local drive. I don’t like being married to a company that stores all of my data. I want control of where this information is stored for years to come. I feel storing on the app’s cloud without a local backup is unwise. Looking foreword to further updates. But it is already a great product, so you don’t need to wait any longer. And they back up their desire to provide the best product they can produce by providing a “pay what you feel it is worth” fee schedule that you can change up or down at any time. It is simply a no brainer to try this product. I hope you are impressed as well.

reviews.title: Love the features, but the dollar amount on individual items keeps turning up way wrong
reviews.text: I thought this app was so cool, especially because you could select individual items within receipts and move them to different folders or categories. For example if I bought home goods and personal items, I could select the personal items to go in that folder and the home goods to go in a separate folder. That is amazing. However, the whole concept is ruined because the scanner doesn’t input the amounts of those items correctly. The amount as a whole is correct but it kept getting WAY off when it came to each item within a receipt. Deleted my subscription right away. If they can fix that issue within the app it would be well worth the 24 dollars a year
